title: Automated 96 Well Plate Protein Reduction and Alkylation Using Beckman Biomek NxP Workstation
author: ronan o'cualain
materials: You will be prompted by the software to enter the location of the first column to be processed. If your first samples are in column A1 to H1 on your sample plate, enter " 1 " You will then be prompted to enter the value of the last column to be processed. If you have a full plate of 96 samples, enter " 12 ". All wells will be processed.

The software will ask you to check that the deck layout matches that of the program. Once you are satisfied that this is the case, click OK. The instrument will now reduce, alkylate, and quench the samples.

You will be prompted by the software to enter the location of the first column to be processed. If your first samples are in column A1 to H1 on your sample plate, enter " 1 " You will then be prompted to enter the value of the last column to be processed. If you have a full plate of 96 samples, enter " 12 ". All wells will be processed.

steps.title: Home all axes
steps.instruction: Select the Method tab and click Home to orient and prepare the automated liquid handler.

steps.title: Open reduction‑alkylation method
steps.instruction: In the File menu choose Open → Method and select the ProteinLysateReductionAlkylationV01 method.

steps.title: Load tip boxes onto deck
steps.instruction: Place two p20 tip boxes and one p250 tip box on the NxP deck as indicated in the deck layout.

steps.title: Load sample plate
steps.instruction: Place the sample plate containing proteins to be reduced/alkylated on the deck. Use a 96‑well AFA‑Tube TPX plate or eight AFA‑Tube TPX strips in a strip holder; for other plates, enter the plate details in the instrument setup step.

steps.title: Prepare reagent plate
steps.instruction: In an Eppendorf 96/500 µL protein LoBind deep‑well plate add to each of the eight wells of a single column: Column 1 – 500 µL of 100 mM DTT; Column 2 – 250 µL of 100 mM IAM.

steps.title: Verify deck layout
steps.instruction: Confirm that the physical arrangement of tip boxes, reagent plate, and sample plate matches the deck layout defined in the Biomek software to avoid pod damage.

steps.title: Set sample volume (optional)
steps.instruction: The method uses a default liquid sample volume of 120 µL; adjust this value in the plate properties if a different volume is required.

steps.title: Run the method
steps.instruction: Click the green Run icon to start the protocol.

steps.title: Incubate after reduction
steps.instruction: When the system pauses after the reduction step, remove the plate and incubate at 60 °C for 15 minutes (00:15:00), then return the plate to the instrument.

steps.title: Incubate after alkylation
steps.instruction: When the system pauses after the alkylation step, remove the plate, cover it, and incubate at room temperature in the dark for 30 minutes (00:30:00), then return the plate.

steps.title: Post‑run handling
steps.instruction: After the program finishes, proceed to protein concentration estimation or store the samples at –20 °C or –80 °C.

steps.title: Do not reach into instrument
steps.instruction: While the program is running, avoid reaching into the instrument; breaking the light curtain will stop the system.
